newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PROFURN BOOK PRICE REDUCED BY 100 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: PROFURN BOOK PRICE REDUCED BY 100 MLN RAND.

text.p: Protea Furnishers Ltd said on Monday the purchase price for the re-acquisition of its debtors book from First National Bank of Southern Africa Ltd was reduced by 100 million rand.

In terms of the acquisition agreement announced in April the price would be settled by the allotment and issue of 128.30 million Profurn shares at 120 cents each and a cash payment of 100 million rand funded by a 100 million rand loan from FNB.
The 100 million rand would be reduced if Profurn shares reached 255 cents per share. Profurn shares closed at 262 cents on Friday.
Profurn said the 100 million rand would be set-off against the loan and the cost of the net assets attributable to the business would be reduced by such amount.
As a result interest would no longer be payable on the loan and Profurn's earnings per share for the year ending December 1997 would increase accordingly.
